what: From 01223, judged by usefulness. hir-def macro_expansion_tests::builtin_errors::{from_derive_errors, coerce_pointee_errors_have_their_code}: a builtin derive error (`#[derive(From)]` used on an enum, the CoercePointee E0802 errors) points at the `derive` ident where the expectation points at the derive's name (`From`, `CoercePointee`). The name is the useful place, because one #[derive(..)] lists several macros and the error is about one of them. Make the error's span the derive path's (the derive_index entry of MacroCallKind::Derive), not the attribute's `derive` ident.
